messages.subject: how udpate input values independently for interactive tables
parts:
I added checkbox in the table in shiny follow the examples which implementing it with java scripts in order to have realize interactivity.
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/26026740/rstudio-shiny-list-from-checking-rows-in-datatables

It allows the user to choose the rows which they want to keep.

My problem is there are two interactive tables. When the user choose certain rows, for example, the 1st and 5th row on the first interactive table.
I used input$rows1 to store number of choose rows, so now input$rows1 = c(1, 5), this value will be used to subset the data and show the updated table as the second interactive table.

The second interactive table will only have tow rows, 1st and 5th rows from the first table.
And then the user choose one of these two rows on the second table, say, 1st row, and I store the chose number in input$rows2, I expect input$rows2 = 1
But in fact input$rows2=c(1,5,1), which means input$rows2 can not be updated independent, it will always include the value of input$rows1.

I paste the example as following:

server:

library(shiny)
mymtcars <- mtcars
mymtcars$id = 1:nrow(mymtcars)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  rowSelect <- reactive({
    paste(sort(unique(input[["rows"]])),sep=',')
  })
  output$mytable = renderDataTable({
    addCheckboxButtons <- paste0('<input type="checkbox" selected= "', mymtcars$id, '"  name="row', mymtcars$id, '" value= "', mymtcars$id, '">',"")
    #Display table with checkbox buttons
    cbind(Pick=addCheckboxButtons, mymtcars)
  }, options = list(orderClasses = TRUE, lengthMenu = c(5, 25, 50), pageLength = 25, paging=FALSE)
    , callback = "function(table) {
    table.on('change.dt', 'tr td input:checkbox', function() {
    setTimeout(function () {
    Shiny.onInputChange('rows1', $(this).add('tr td input:checkbox:checked').parent().siblings(':last-child').map(function() {
    return $(this).text();
    }).get())
    }, 10);
    });
}")

  output$textMessage =renderText({
    paste(c('You selected these rows on the page:', input[["rows1"]]),
      collapse = ',')
   
  })
 
  output$updatedTable =renderDataTable({
    selectrows <- as.numeric(input[["rows1"]])
    updatedTable <- mymtcars[selectrows, -which(colnames(mymtcars) == "id")] 
    updatedTable$id  <- 1:nrow(updatedTable)
    addCheckboxButtons <- paste0('<input type="checkbox" selected= "', updatedTable$id, '"  name="row', updatedTable$id, '" value= "', updatedTable$id, '">',"")
    cbind(Pick=addCheckboxButtons, updatedTable)
  }, options = list(orderClasses = TRUE, lengthMenu = c(5, 25, 50), pageLength = 25, paging=FALSE)
    , callback = "function(table) {
    table.on('change.dt', 'tr td input:checkbox', function() {
    setTimeout(function () {
    Shiny.onInputChange('rows2', $(this).add('tr td input:checkbox:checked').parent().siblings(':last-child').map(function() {
    return $(this).text();
    }).get())
    }, 10);
    });
    }")

  output$textMessage2 =renderText({
    paste(c('You selected these rows on the page:', input[["rows2"]]),
      collapse = ',')  
  })
  })

UI:
library(shiny)
data(cars)
mymtcars <- cars
mymtcars$id = 1:nrow(cars)
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(headerPanel('Examples of DataTables'),
  sidebarPanel(
    #                          checkboxGroupInput('show_vars', 'Columns to show:', names(mymtcars),
    #                                             selected = names(mymtcars))
    #                           ,textInput("collection_txt",label="Foo")
  ),
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(
      tabPanel("Original Table",
        #                                      htable("mytable",clickId = "xxx",
        #                                             colHeaders="provided",rowNames="enabled",
        #                                             readOnly = F)),
        dataTableOutput("mytable")),
      tabPanel("Text Message", textOutput("textMessage")),
      tabPanel("Updated Table", dataTableOutput("updatedTable")),
      tabPanel("Text Message Updated", textOutput("textMessage2"))
    )
  )
))


The "Text Message" and "Text Message Update" print the number of selected rows of  the first and second interactive table separately.
It can be easily seen that the input values can not be updated independently although I store them in tow variables.

Can anybody help me with it?
Thanks a lot in advance.

messages.subject: Re: how udpate input values independently for interactive tables
parts:
Thanks for the concern , I have solved the problem.
I assign the checked rows of different tables to separate variable.
Because the original codes :

send the checked rows of all interactive tables to the variable input$rows1

For example:
    addCheckboxButtons <- paste0('<input type="checkbox" name="check1" selected= "', mymtcars$id, '"  ', mymtcars$id, '" value= "', mymtcars$id, '">',"")
    Shiny.onInputChange('rows1', $(this).add('tr td input:checkbox[name=check1]:checked').

The same changes should be done for the second interactive tables.

Hope it is helpful to other people.

Jie
